title: Innate Pharma to host conference call and webcast on september 17 for first half 2026 financial results and business update
body_markdown:
** Thu, 09/10/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”), today announced that the Company will hold a conference call on Thursday, September 17, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. CEST / 8:00 a.m. EDT, to provide a business update for the first half of 2026.


Participants in the call will be:


- Jonathan Dickinson, Chief Executive Officer


- Markus Jensen, Vice President, Chief Medical Officer


- Yannis Morel, Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer


- Frédéric Lombard, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer


Event Details


-


Date and time: September 17, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. CEST / 8:00 a.m. EDT


-


Webcast link:


[Click here](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/781747499)


-


Conference call link:


[Click here](https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/781747499?pwd=oh5mVlXf)


This information is


also available on the Investors section of the Innate Pharma website,


[www.innate-pharma.com](http://www.innate-pharma.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company website for 90 days following the event.
